product.ta-dsd.summary: The TA DSD was a terminal for accessing DATEV applications with an identification card.
product.ta-dsd.history: Triumph-Adler supplied it for users of interactive DATEV applications. Queries could be displayed on screen or recorded on paper.
product.ta-dsd.technical.configuration: The magnetic card enabled access. The manual specifies a built-in electrosensitive printer rated at 2,200 characters per second.
product.ta-dsd.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-dsd.technical.limitations: Model-specific firmware and startup verification remain pending.
